sanskrit_verse:
mithyāsaṃpratipattiś ca pratyavaskandanaṃ tathā /
prāṅnyāyaś cottarāḥ proktāś catvāraḥ śāstravedibhiḥ // BrhS_1,2.2
transliteration: mithyāsaṃpratipattiś ca pratyavaskandanaṃ tathā / prāṅnyāyaś cottarāḥ proktāś catvāraḥ śāstravedibhiḥ // BrhS_1,2.2
sph_interpretive_translation: False cognition, counter-assertion, pre-trial examination, and post-trial review—are the fourfold procedural instruments declared by scriptural authorities.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Satyam, not institutional hierarchy
Causation is established through conscious participation in dharma-vyavahara
Capacity-based responsibility is assessed through clarity of cognition and intent
Restoration logic operates through sequential correction of misapprehension
Consciousness alignment is prerequisite for valid legal engagement
executable_legal_axioms: IF participant exhibits mithyāsaṃpratipatti, THEN initiate pramāṇa-based realignment process
IF pratyavaskandana occurs, THEN deploy śāstra-aligned refutation protocol without punitive attribution
IF prāṅnyāya is invoked, THEN execute pre-adjudication clarity assessment
IF uttarāḥ review is requested, THEN activate anupūrvaśaḥ restoration sequence
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, these four instruments function as thresholds for validating the dharmic integrity of a case. Mithyāsaṃpratipatti disqualifies proceedings unless realigned with satyam. Pratyavaskandana ensures rebuttal capacity remains rooted in śāstra. Prāṅnyāya confirms pre-trial clarity, and uttarāḥ guarantees post-decision integration with dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that false apprehension disrupts dharma-vyavahara. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures correction follows manifestation sequence without punitive overlay. Responsibility is proportional to conscious distortion. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that justice restores cognition, not inflicts consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Deploy śākṣātkaar processes for pratyavaskandana validation
Activate prāṅnyāya clarity workshops for involved parties
Implement uttarāḥ integration councils for post-resolution alignment
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Dharma. False cognition corrected, counter-assertion purified, pre-trial clarified, post-trial integrated—thus dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
